test_title: PYST 28: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Tiya, Tarun, Shyam, Jiya, Varun and Ram are sitting around a circle, facing the centre. Ram sits third to the right of Tarun. Tarun sits second to the right of Tiya. Shyam sits to the immediate right of Varun. Who sits second to the right of Tarun?
solution:
Tiya, Tarun, Shyam, Jiya, Varun and Ram are sitting around a circle, facing the centre.

 
• Ram sits third to the right of Tarun.
 
• Tarun sits second to the right of Tiya.
 
• Shyam sits to the immediate right of Varun.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
